# Flowbite datepicker (vendored)

`Datepicker.umd.js` and `datepicker.css` are copied unchanged from
`flowbite-datepicker@2.0.0` (dist), MIT licensed, by Themesberg / Flowbite.
Copied instead of installed so the Worker serves the calendar without a build
step; `public/app.js` initialises it on every `input[type="date"]`.
